Definition: to issue, i.e. furnish; causatively, to secure; figuratively, to succeed
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bring out, furnish, promote, go out, issue; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to produce, furnish; 1a2) to bring out, elicit, obtain, cause to come out from; 1a3) to promote; 1a4) to cause to go out to
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
